newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in Wednesday's modest trade with blue chips accounting for most of the activity.
* Of 15 active stocks four rose, five fell and six were unchanged.
* Volume fell to 9,596 shares and turnover was halved at 10.00 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was hotelier Arenaturist which rose nine kuna to 149 on volume of 220 shares.
* Leading loser was Varazdinska Banka first issue ordinary share, down 4,000 kuna to 45,000 with only 16 units sold.
* Most actively traded stock was fully listed Zagrebacka banka which closed 0.20 kuna higher at 2,000.20 kuna on volume of 3,415 units. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
